turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: The mechanism is specifically worth sitting with. The association isn't saying AI is ordering unnecessary tests. They're saying providers are billing for more severe patient care. Which means AI is either helping clinicians identify severity they would have previously missed — which is arguably good —

turns.speaker: RUFUS
turns.text: or it's making a billing argument that the insurer doesn't believe reflects genuine clinical complexity.

turns.speaker: ALEX
turns.text: And the association covers more than a hundred million people across 31 independent insurers. So this isn't a regional quirk.

turns.speaker: JAMIE
turns.text: What's the limit on the finding, though? Because this is the insurer's study, not an independent audit.
